title: docs(skills): the platform and upgrade skills teach engines.protocol '^19', the major the 19.x boot handshake accepts

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgFiXLbrG7d8JVydkmtSf4Bt)_

Fixes #37460

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 客户项目里的 AI 助手照着技能包写应用配置时,声明的协议大版本从 18 变成 19;技能包的考题也同步改成 19。
- 属于「19.0.0 大版本」这条线:运行时的协议版本升到 19 之后,技能包要教同一个数,否则照抄的配置启动就被拒。
- 若它早于协议升 19 的那个改动上线,照着技能写的新项目会在 18 版运行时上启动被拒;纯文字改动,可以直接撤回。
- 要你做一件事:「进入预发布阶段」和「协议升到 19」两个改动都已合入,请审批这个受管的技能包改动。

## What changes

PR 2 of 2 for the card (seat direction: option A on the shape of the v18 move). This is the `skills/**` half, split off because `skills/**` is a governed surface. The sibling PR 1 moves `PROTOCOL_VERSION` to `19.0.0` and every other tracked `'^18'` on branch `claude/issue-37229-protocol-version-19` (PR #37314). PR 1 and #37230 (pre mode plus the pending `@objectstack/spec` major) are both on `main`, so the landing order this PR waited on is met. It stays draft because `skills/**` is Tier H.

Four lines in three files, each rewritten in place at equal byte length:

- `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` L111: the `defineStack` manifest example declares `engines: { protocol: '^19' }` (was `'^18'`).
- `skills/objectstack-platform/evals/config-plugins-ops.json` L6 and L7: eval 1's prompt asks for `protocol 19` and its expected output is `'^19'`, so the eval stays consistent with the skill it scores.
- `skills/objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md` L89: the sentence that says what every scaffold and example writes now says `'^19'`.
- `.changeset/37229-skills-protocol-19.md`: `@objectstack/skills` patch.

`git grep -n "protocol: '\^18'" -- skills/` at head `3536f9ac1c` matches nothing.

**Rework round (head `3536f9ac1c`).** Two commits on top of `c9ad209e`: a merge of `origin/main` `a46efa8c62` (clean, no conflict, no generated artifact deferred) and one sentence in the changeset. The changeset's last sentence used to end "no conversion is registered at step 19, so the chain an author replays still ends at 18"; with PR 1 on `main` the chain ends at 19. It now ends: "step 19 carries no conversion and one semantic entry (`protocol-18-range-refused`)." The entry id was read on `origin/main` `a46efa8c62` at `packages/spec/src/migrations/entries/semantic/19.protocol-18-range-refused.ts`, the only `19.*` file under `entries/`. The changeset file is new in this PR, so this is not an edit to a landed note. The PR's own hunks in the three skill files are unchanged from `c9ad209e`. The eval file and the upgrade skill keep the same blobs. `skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` changed blob only by main's merged hunks (#37409, #37303).

**Declarations, judged from content.** The diff is skill prose and one eval fixture. It changes nothing a metadata author can write and nothing the runtime accepts or refuses; the refusal of `'^18'` is PR 1's. So `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none`, the same pair the v18 skills move (#25688) declared, and the changeset is `patch`. No `Skills-docs:` line is owed for a `none` kind.

## Tests

No workspace package source is touched, so no package test is owed. The marked `defineStack` example in `objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` is type-checked by `check:skill-examples`: `350 prose examples type-check across 3 surface(s)`, exit 0, after a full core build (121 of 121 turbo tasks, lock `VERDICT command-exit 0`).

## Acceptance notes

- **No 18 → 19 step is added to `objectstack-upgrade`.** The skill does not walk the majors one by one; it teaches one procedure (`os migrate meta --from N`, then the residue). On `main` `a46efa8c62` step 19 carries no conversion and one semantic entry (`protocol-18-range-refused`), whose own replacement text names `migrate meta --from 18`, the procedure the skill already teaches, so no step-19 text is added.
- **Left unchanged on purpose in `objectstack-upgrade/SKILL.md`:**
  - L74, `os migrate meta --from 16 --to 18 --json`. It names the last ported hop, not the current major. The chain now has steps for 17, 18 and 19. Step 19 carries no conversion, so the `--to 18` replay gives the same result as the default terminus 19 today. The skill's own eval pins the same replay form.
  - L91, the `'^17'` to `--from 17` worked example (it shows taking the floor of a range).
  - L122 ("not in the 18 catalog") and L178 to L183 ("18.3 drops", "on 18.2 or earlier"): statements about 18.x releases, still true.
- **Frontmatter is the version pass's.** `compatibility: Requires @objectstack/spec 18.x` and `metadata.version: "18.6.0"` in the skill frontmatter are stamped at release; `check:skill-compatibility` exits 0 at this head.
- **Order risk, now past.** Before PR 1 the skill would have taught `'^19'` to an 18 runtime. PR 1 is on `main`.
- Noted, not filed (carrier: none): nothing cross-checks a `protocol:` literal in skill prose against `PROTOCOL_VERSION`; the v18 skills move noted the same.
